summary.business_type: SaaS / jobs marketplace (visa-sponsored software roles, Europe)
top_findings: www and apex both return 200 without consolidation
No rel=canonical on any public page
Homepage H1 undersells visa/relocation keywords in the title
Schema gaps: no SearchAction, SoftwareApplication, or JobPosting
quick_wins: Rewrite homepage H1 for sponsorship intent
Add sitemap lastmod + visible Updated dates on country pages

findings.title: www and apex both live
findings.description: https://kuchup.com/ and https://www.kuchup.com/ both return 200 without redirect, splitting signals.
findings.recommendation: 301 the non-preferred host to the preferred host; align absolute links and Search Console.

findings.title: Missing canonical tags
findings.description: No link rel=canonical on crawled marketing pages.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonicals on the chosen host for every indexable URL.

findings.title: Cache-Control: no-store on HTML
findings.description: Public HTML is uncacheable, hurting repeat TTFB/LCP headroom.
findings.recommendation: Use short TTL or SWR for marketing HTML; reserve no-store for authenticated surfaces.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.description: HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy absent on homepage responses.
findings.recommendation: Add headers via Cloudflare or Caddy.

findings.title: Favicon 404
findings.description: /favicon.ico, /favicon.svg, /apple-touch-icon.png return 404.
findings.recommendation: Publish a favicon set and reference it in HTML.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Strong unique titles on country pages
High QRG quality scores (91–93) with low AI-pattern noise

findings.title: Homepage H1/title mismatch
findings.description: Title targets visa-sponsored software roles; H1 is generic brand voice.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite H1 to include visa/relocation/software outcome language.

findings.title: Thin pricing and how-it-works pages
findings.description: Pricing ~153 words; How it Works ~249 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand with substantive unique copy (plans, limits, eligibility, workflow detail).

findings.title: Brand naming split
findings.description: UI uses KUCHUP; titles/schema often Relocation Jobs.
findings.recommendation: Pick primary entity name; keep the other as alternateName consistently.

findings.title: Country pages need live inventory
findings.description: SERP consensus is guide+jobs; pages are FAQ-heavy guides.
findings.recommendation: Surface live role counts and sample jobs above the fold.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles and meta descriptions on sitemap pages
index, follow robots meta on marketing pages

findings.title: Missing og:image
findings.description: og:title and og:description exist but og:image is null; /og.png 404.
findings.recommendation: Add a 1200×630 social image and og:image absolute URL.

findings.title: Meta descriptions overlong
findings.description: Several descriptions are 165–215 characters and will truncate in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Tighten to ~150–160 characters with primary benefit first.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Valid FAQPage markup on MCP and country pages

findings.title: No WebSite SearchAction
findings.description: WebSite node lacks potentialAction search.
findings.recommendation: Add SearchAction targeting the public board/search URL.

findings.title: Missing SoftwareApplication / JobPosting
findings.description: Product is a software app/jobs board but schema does not declare it.
findings.recommendation: Add SoftwareApplication on product pages; JobPosting/ItemList for public roles when accurate.

findings.title: FAQPage Google rich results retired
findings.description: FAQ rich results retired for all sites May 7, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Keep for UX/citability if useful; do not add FAQPage for Google SERP benefit.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: SSR, light homepage (no img tags), fast apex TTFB in curl (~0.27s)

findings.title: PSI/CrUX data unavailable
findings.description: Anonymous PSI rate-limited; no Google API credentials for CrUX.
findings.recommendation: Configure GOOGLE_API_KEY and re-run pagespeed/CrUX checks.

findings.title: Uncacheable HTML
findings.description: Cache-Control no-store on public documents.
findings.recommendation: Enable caching for marketing HTML.

findings.title: llms.txt missing
findings.description: /llms.txt returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Optional: publish llms.txt summarizing product and canonical URLs.

findings.title: Weak entity/authority signals
findings.description: Only GitHub sameAs; domain absent from Common Crawl graph.
findings.recommendation: Expand sameAs, publish methodology, pursue citations/PR.

findings.title: Low multi-modal content
findings.description: Almost no images, charts, or video.
findings.recommendation: Add product screenshots and simple visa/process diagrams.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No missing-alt debt on content images (none present)

findings.title: No content images or OG asset
findings.description: Homepage img_count=0; social/favicon assets 404.
findings.recommendation: Ship OG image, favicon, and at least one product UI screenshot.

categories.name: SXO
what_works: Search-first UX with clear Find roles CTA
Country URLs closer to SERP guide pattern

findings.title: Homepage page-type mismatch vs sponsorship SERPs
findings.description: SERP consensus is guide+jobs index; homepage is product landing.
findings.recommendation: Add sponsorship snapshot section on home or push SEO weight to country hubs with live jobs.

findings.title: Domain not in Common Crawl rankings
findings.description: kuchup.com missing from cc-main-2026-jan-feb-mar graph.
findings.recommendation: Earn external citations; re-check after indexing/PR; add Moz/Bing keys for ongoing tracking.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Country pages: live jobs above fold
